summary: The compact one-storey form, pale hipped roof, southwest window, and single side entrance make the studio recognizable, but conspicuous surface treatments weaken fidelity.

orientation.summary: SV1 is located southwest of the studio and looks northeast, so it jointly exposes the +v (WSW) and +u (SSE) faces. The reference shows the rectangular window on the southwest-facing +v wall and the entrance on the adjacent side. The render matches this with a +v window and one unique principal door on +u; no duplicated principal portal is present.

issues.problem: The model uses pronounced red-brick wall texture, whereas the street view shows a brown-clad studio without visible masonry coursing.
issues.fix: Replace the brick pattern with subdued brown siding or shingle-like cladding while retaining the existing massing and white trim.

issues.problem: The pale roof has a chunky shingle pattern rather than the reference’s smoother pale-metal character.
issues.fix: Use a cleaner light metal roof treatment with subtle seams and keep the low hipped silhouette and projecting eaves.
